review.summary: Mercedes lead the championship with 578 points after 17 rounds, having taken 11 wins and 22 podiums. Andrea Kimi Antonelli tops the drivers' standings ahead of teammate George Russell, who sits second.

Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole for Red Bull, taking a straightforward victory. Charles Leclerc finished second for Ferrari with the fastest lap, and Andrea Kimi Antonelli took third for Mercedes. The classification shows a front-row start converted into a win, while George Russell recovered from nineteenth on the grid to ninth.
highlights: Isack Hadjar climbed twelve places from twenty-second on the grid to finish tenth and score a point for Red Bull.
Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap of the Singapore Grand Prix while finishing second for Ferrari.
George Russell recovered from nineteenth on the grid to finish ninth, taking two points for Mercedes.
